t: 阿方索二世成为那不勒斯的国王.
te: Alfonso II becomes King of Naples.
dz: 阿方索二世成为那不勒斯的国王.
de: Alfonso II becomes King of Naples.

t: 在第二次前往新大陆的航行中，克里斯托弗·哥伦布看到了牙买加，在愉景湾登陆，并宣布牙买加为西班牙…
te: On his second voyage to the New World, Christopher Columbus sights Jamaica, landing at Discovery Bay and declares Jamai…
dz: 在第二次前往新大陆的航行中，克里斯托弗·哥伦布看到了牙买加，在愉景湾登陆，并宣布牙买加为西班牙王室的财产。
de: On his second voyage to the New World, Christopher Columbus sights Jamaica, landing at Discovery Bay and declares Jamaica the property of the Spanish crown.

t: 一个修道士约翰·科尔记录了第一批已知的威士忌.
te: A monk, John Cor, records the first known batch of Scotch whisky.
dz: 一个修道士约翰·科尔记录了第一批已知的威士忌.
de: A monk, John Cor, records the first known batch of Scotch whisky.

t: 西班牙和葡萄牙签署"托德西拉斯条约",将两国分出新世界.
te: Spain and Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas which divides the New World between the two countries.
dz: 西班牙和葡萄牙签署"托德西拉斯条约",将两国分出新世界.
de: Spain and Portugal sign the Treaty of Tordesillas which divides the New World between the two countries.

t: "托德西拉斯条约"由西班牙批准.
te: The Treaty of Tordesillas is ratified by Spain.
dz: 发现时代:"托德西拉斯条约"由西班牙批准.
de: Age of Discovery: The Treaty of Tordesillas is ratified by Spain.

t: 法国国王查理八世占领了意大利佛罗伦萨.
te: French King Charles VIII occupies Florence, Italy.
dz: 法国国王查理八世占领了意大利佛罗伦萨.
